description: Check a birth chart for the commonly cited Pitra dosha combinations: the Sun with Rahu or Ketu, Rahu or Ketu in the 9th house, the Sun with Saturn in the 9th house, and the 9th lord with Rahu or Ketu. Lists each combination found. Birth time is needed for the house-based checks.

language.description: Set to "hi" to add Hindi (Devanagari) names next to the English ones, for answering in Hindi.

time.description: Local birth time, HH:MM. Without it only the Sun-Rahu and Sun-Ketu checks are made.

name: check_pitra_dosha
title: Pitra dosha check
